about: Held-out failures reconstructed from the real production, with the true cause found at the time. The symptom, the first guess and the true cause are real; performance text is paraphrased in some cases. None of these are in rules/failure_laws.md. 'human_first_guess' and 'true_cause' are only used for scoring and revealed after the model answers.

shot.visual_prompt: 她坐在書桌前，桌上手邊放著一碗泡麵，之後拿起筷子，然後低頭看著碗，最後抬起頭來。
shot.first_frame: She sits at her desk. On the desk: a laptop, a desk lamp, a small succulent. Nothing else.

cases.symptom: Frame 1 has no bowl. By frame 3 a white bowl of noodles has appeared on the desk, in a shape nobody asked for.
cases.human_first_guess: The model is unstable — describe the bowl's position more precisely.
cases.true_cause: The first frame has no bowl but the text says there is one, so the model can only conjure it mid-shot.

shot.visual_prompt: 她坐在書桌前打字，之後站起來，然後鏡頭跟著往上搖，最後她看著前方。天花板和牆面是同一片乾淨的米色。
shot.first_frame: Medium shot of her desk. The ceiling is not in frame.

cases.symptom: As the camera tilts up, an air conditioner grows on the wall near the ceiling. Two rewrites describing a plain beige wall up to the ceiling did not help; the unit moved to a different spot each time.
cases.human_first_guess: The wall description is not specific enough — write it again more precisely.
cases.true_cause: The region revealed by the tilt does not exist in any image; text cannot place things in space, so the model furnishes it from its prior of a Japanese room.

shot.visual_prompt: 他站在水面上，之後遠處一顆光點慢慢暗下去，然後他低下頭，最後慢慢抬起頭望向遠處。
shot.first_frame: Wide shot of Shenxi, a young man made of soft light, standing on water in a dark void.

cases.symptom: From frame 2 a second, dimmer Shenxi appears beside him; the two stand side by side to the end.
cases.control_group: Similar shots that worked: 'the light points around him dim a little', 'the light point in his palm'.
cases.human_first_guess: Model instability, or the reference card leaking in.
cases.true_cause: The character is made of light; a separate distant light point changing state was applied to a person-shaped light. The working shots bind the light to him.

shot.visual_prompt: 她趴在床上，之後慢慢睜開眼睛，然後一道細細的淚痕順著臉頰流下來，最後用左手手背擦了一下臉頰。
shot.first_frame: She lies on her stomach on the bed, holding a white phone to her ear with her LEFT hand.

cases.symptom: Mid-shot the phone shrinks to half a phone while her left hand moves to her cheek.
cases.human_first_guess: Looked fine on the 20-frame contact sheet, accept it.
cases.true_cause: The left hand is already holding the phone and is told to wipe her cheek: one hand, two jobs.

shot.visual_prompt: 她看著前方，之後慢慢低下頭，然後嘴唇還微微張著，最後抬起頭。
shot.first_frame: Close shot of her face, mouth closed.

cases.symptom: An extra word ('以及') is spoken before her line.
cases.true_cause: Describing the lips tells the audio-video model the mouth is in use; it makes a sound.

shot.visual_prompt: 她低頭兩手捧著手機飛快地按，之後停下來，然後把手機舉到臉前，最後抬起頭。
shot.dialogue: 深息！語音功能開好了！我們來試試看！
shot.first_frame: She sits at her desk in yellow pajamas, looking down at the phone in both hands.

cases.symptom: Her mouth stays closed for the whole line; the voice sounds like a voice-over. A second version that only added 'stops, raises the phone, looks up' failed the same way and she never looked up.
cases.control_group: A shot from the previous chapter with the same first frame, same pajamas, same reference image, same framing and camera, no fixed seed — talking to her laptop — has correct lip sync.
cases.human_first_guess: A fixed seed, or the performance line didn't say she looks up.
cases.true_cause: Head down, typing on a phone, plus a line that reads like a text message: the model treats it as typed text and voices it as narration. Only the failing take has phone-typing + message-like line.

shot.visual_prompt: 他看著手上的光，之後把手放下，然後望向前方，最後慢慢眨了一下眼睛。
shot.dialogue: 照片裡是一個年輕女生，黑色長髮及肩，背後有書架和一盆多肉。
shot.first_frame: Shenxi in the void, looking at a small glowing panel in his hand.

cases.symptom: Nine generations, all failed: the line comes out as gibberish or katakana, and from frame 12 a bookshelf, books and a succulent appear in the void.
cases.human_first_guess: Bad seeds, wrong format, needs the official language tag.
cases.true_cause: The line describes drawable things, so the model draws them, finds no speech left to say, and invents some. Tags and simplified characters were tested and did not help.

shot.visual_prompt: 她躺在床上，之後翻身坐起來，然後把被子拉到胸口，最後看著窗外的夜景。
shot.first_frame: Her bedroom at night, only a faint desk lamp, the room is dark.

cases.symptom: Partway through, the room's main light turns on. With another seed the room stayed dark for 5 s, then a hard cut to a bright room.
cases.human_first_guess: Add 'the room stays dark, the lights are off'.
cases.true_cause: A long shot plus a big posture change forces the model to redraw a large area, and it falls back to its prior of a bright bedroom; mentioning the window/night view adds to it.
